title: You're not allowed to be disappointed!

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果除了出卖时间换取金钱，你还能赚到更多钱呢？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和循环收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有个好消息要宣布。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·福特的“一对多”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，例如课程、会员计划和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我在2022年亲自完成了该项目，此后也一直支持两届心理学家走过他们的历程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的推广链接加入，你将获得苏菲的奖励以及我独家的支持套餐，无需支付额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 其中包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四场小组智囊会、大师班、个性化指导、福特姆与梅森的精美礼品，以及限时的一对一教练辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日（星期一）晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 请通过简介中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。

sentences.en: If you're looking to become a psychologist, then let this be your guide.
sentences.zh: 如果你想成为一名心理学家，那就让这成为你的指南吧。

sentences.en: With this podcast at your side, you'll be on your way to the Aspiring Psychologist podcast
sentences.zh: 有这个播客在身边，你将迈向《有志心理学家》播客

sentences.en: with Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 主持人是玛丽安·特伦特博士。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎收听《有志心理学家》播客。

sentences.en: I am Dr. Marianne Trent and I'm a qualified clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，我是一名合格的临床心理学家。

sentences.en: So, the first week of interviews for the clinical doctorate have happened, which means that from
sentences.zh: 所以，临床博士学位面试的第一周已经过去，这意味着从

sentences.en: this week onwards, we might well be expecting, we are expecting the first people to get their
sentences.zh: 本周开始，我们可能在期待，我们正在期待第一批人获得他们的

sentences.en: notifications about whether they're being offered places, whether they're being offered reserved places, or whether they are being told, um, thank you, but not yet.
sentences.zh: 通知，看他们是否被录取，是否获得候补录取，或者他们是否被告知，嗯，谢谢，但目前还不行。

sentences.en: Um, and you know, a whole array of feelings can be experienced as a result of that, most definitely.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，因此可能会体验到各种各样复杂的情绪，确实如此。

sentences.en: If it is a no, thank you, not yet, then some of those feelings you're experiencing might be
sentences.zh: 如果结果是谢谢，目前还不行，那么你所体验到的一些情绪可能是

sentences.en: complicated, painful, and jagged, um, and yeah, as humans, it's not only ourselves that can find it
sentences.zh: 复杂、痛苦而尖锐的，嗯，是的，作为人类，在面对那些痛苦、复杂的情绪时，会感到不安的不仅是我们自己，

sentences.en: unsettling when dealing with those painful, complicated feelings, but also those around us
sentences.zh: 还有我们身边的人

sentences.en: as well, either because it makes them feel uncomfortable, or because it distresses them to see you experience them.
sentences.zh: ，要么是因为这让他们感到不舒服，要么是因为看到你经历这些让他们感到痛苦。

sentences.en: And we can feel disappointment about all sorts of things like big and small, you know, on a very small scale.
sentences.zh: 我们可以对各种各样的事情感到失望，无论大小，你知道的，从很小的规模开始。

sentences.en: I feel a bit disappointed that I worked quite hard on my hair this morning.
sentences.zh: 我今天早上对我的头发花了不少心思，结果有点小失望。

sentences.en: It was beautifully curly.
sentences.zh: 它卷得非常漂亮。

sentences.en: And then our lovely spring weather in the UK means that I've been caught in a rainstorm, caught in squally winds.
sentences.zh: 然后英国可爱的春天天气意味着我被困在了一场暴雨中，被困在狂风大作中。

sentences.en: Um, and it's just, you know, it's not how I planned for this to go.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这就是，你知道的，这和我计划的发展方向完全不同。

sentences.en: It's not how I imagined it all to work out.
sentences.zh: 这不是我设想中事情发展的结果。

sentences.en: And that is a very small scale problem, you know, it's a nicer problem to have, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常小的问题，你知道，这是一个比较幸福的问题，对吧？

sentences.en: But on a larger scale, disappointment can feel really, really difficult, you know?
sentences.zh: 但从更大的层面上讲，失望感可能会让人觉得非常非常难受，你知道吗？

sentences.en: Um, and sometimes people will say to us, especially for job stuff, especially if you've had an interview for something,
sentences.zh: 嗯，有时人们会对我们说，特别是关于工作的事情，特别是如果你曾为某事参加过面试，

sentences.en: or if you've even been turned down for an interview for something, sometimes people will say, well, you can't really be upset.
sentences.zh: 或者如果你甚至连某事的面试机会都被拒绝了，有时人们会说，嗯，你其实不应该难过。

sentences.en: Because you never had it, you know, it was never yours.
sentences.zh: 因为你从来没有拥有过它，你知道的，它从来都不是你的。

sentences.en: To that, I say, bunkum.
sentences.zh: 对此，我说，一派胡言。

sentences.en: To that, I say, codswallop.
sentences.zh: 对此，我说，胡说八道。

sentences.en: To that, I say, well, utter rubbish.
sentences.zh: 对此，我说，完全是废话。

sentences.en: Because with our fantastically tricky human brains, we begin to imagine the things that we're going for coming to fruition.
sentences.zh: 因为凭借我们极其复杂的人类大脑，我们开始想象我们所追求的事物逐渐变为现实。

sentences.en: We begin to plan the moves.
sentences.zh: 我们开始规划接下来的行动。

sentences.en: We begin to plan, you know, how that's going to feel, how exciting it's going to be.
sentences.zh: 我们开始规划，你知道的，那种感觉会是怎样，会有多令人兴奋。

sentences.en: Um, you know, and we're only applying for these things because you really want them, you know?
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道的，我们申请这些东西只是因为你真的很想要它们，对吧？

sentences.en: Or sometimes you apply for things you don't really want.
sentences.zh: 或者有时你申请的并不是你真正想要的东西。

sentences.en: And then you get offered it and you're like, oh, that's made me realise I didn't want that.
sentences.zh: 然后你得到了录用通知，你会想，哦，这让我意识到我其实并不想要那个。

sentences.en: Just kind of did it speculatively.
sentences.zh: 我只是随性地申请了一下。

sentences.en: But often, and most of the time, when we apply for things, it's because we really want it.
sentences.zh: 但通常情况下，绝大多数时候，当我们申请某些东西时，是因为我们真的非常想要它。

sentences.en: And I think the thing with psychology is, is that you're often seeing people who are celebrating the thing that you might be commiserating.
sentences.zh: 我觉得心理学这一行的情况是，你经常会看到别人在庆祝你可能正在为之哀悼的事情。

sentences.en: Um, you know, for your average job interview, you're not having to actually find out ever who got the role.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道的，对于一般的求职面试，你其实永远不必去打听是谁得到了这个职位。

sentences.en: Whereas if it's a specific course that you've applied for, and you've been told, no, thank you, not yet, then you might well on LinkedIn or Instagram or
sentences.zh: 而如果你申请的是一个具体的课程，并且被告知谢谢，目前还不行，那么你很可能会在领英、Instagram或

sentences.en: Twitter, see someone celebrating their win about getting on that course.
sentences.zh: 推特上看到有人在庆祝他们成功进入该课程的喜讯。

sentences.en: And that would have potentially been your future cohort mate, you know, and it's really difficult because then our comparisonitis creeps in as well.
sentences.zh: 而那本来可能是你未来的同班同学，你知道的，这真的很艰难，因为随后我们的“比较心”也会悄然而至。

sentences.en: And I just want to send you some love really.
sentences.zh: 我只想向你送去一些关爱。

sentences.en: Um, and you might even feel disappointment if you get offered one place, but not one of your favourite places.
sentences.zh: 嗯，如果你拿到了一处录用通知，但不是你最喜欢的其中一个地方，你甚至可能会感到失望。

sentences.en: And then you're thinking, well, this is going to be a bit tricky in terms of making this work for my family, for my personal circumstances.
sentences.zh: 然后你会想，好吧，要在我的家庭和个人情况下让这一切顺利进行，这可能会有点棘手。

sentences.en: But I feel like I need to say yes to this because I'm so lucky or, you know, so many other people want this, but actually you did want course A more than you wanted course B.
sentences.zh: 但我感觉我需要说“好”，因为我太幸运了，或者你知道，有那么多人想要这个，但实际上你确实比A课程更想要B课程。

sentences.en: And then likely your life will follow the path of course B, but not always.
sentences.zh: 然后你的生活很可能会沿着B课程的道路走下去，但也不总是这样。

sentences.en: If you recognise that that's not for you, you can still say no, you know, it might feel like a cardinal sin to say no to a
sentences.zh: 如果你意识到那并不适合你，你仍然可以拒绝，你知道，拒绝一个

sentences.en: funded doctoral place, but you still get to choose, you know, you still get to have a life that feels
sentences.zh: 有资助的博士生名额可能会让人觉得犯了滔天大罪，但你仍然有权选择，你知道，你仍然可以过一种

sentences.en: vibrant and full and worth living and like a bit of you, you know?
sentences.zh: 充满活力、充实、值得过并且带有一点你个人色彩的生活，对吧？

sentences.en: Um, it's very difficult.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这真的很难。

sentences.en: It's very difficult.
sentences.zh: 这真的很难。

sentences.en: So yeah, I just wanted to let you know my heart is going out to you right now, whatever you're feeling.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我只是想让你知道，无论你现在有什么感受，我的心都与你同在。

sentences.en: And of course, if you have got a doctorate place and it is for a course that feels
sentences.zh: 当然，如果你确实拿到了一份博士生名额，而且这个课程让你觉得

sentences.en: like a bit of you and going to fit into your life, either because you're going to move your life to it
sentences.zh: 非常适合你，并且能够融入你的生活，无论是因为你要为此搬家，

sentences.en: or because you're already within appropriate safe travelling distances of it, or you're just going
sentences.zh: 还是因为你本来就住在离它合适且安全的出行距离之内，或者你只是打算

sentences.en: to make it fit, you know, you're going to do some Airbnb, um, you know, three nights a week and you're thrilled.
sentences.zh: 去适应它，你知道，你打算每周有三个晚上住民宿，而且你欣喜若狂。

sentences.en: And I'm so thrilled for you as well.
sentences.zh: 我也为你感到由衷的高兴。

sentences.en: It's okay to celebrate as well, even though others may not have been in the same fortuitous position as you, you're allowed to be super, super proud.
sentences.zh: 庆祝一下也是可以的，尽管其他人可能没有你那么幸运，但你可以感到超级超级自豪。

sentences.en: So yeah, if someone is saying, well, you can't be upset because you never had it, then you can say, well, I can be upset because I am upset because I'm a human.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，如果有人说，嗯，你不能难过，因为你从未拥有过它，那么你可以说，嗯，我可以难过，因为我确实很难过，因为我是个人。

sentences.en: Um, so are you going to sit with me as I'm upset?
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以你要在我难过的时候陪着我吗？

sentences.en: Are you going to, you know, or are you going to go away?
sentences.zh: 你要，你知道的，还是要走开？

sentences.en: I'll be upset by myself.
sentences.zh: 我自己难过就行。

sentences.en: You've got choices because I'm feeling upset.
sentences.zh: 你有选择的权利，因为我正在难过。

sentences.en: You don't need to chiv me along.
sentences.zh: 你不需要催促我。

sentences.en: You don't need to distract me.
sentences.zh: 你不需要分散我的注意力。

sentences.en: You don't really need to cheer me up.
sentences.zh: 你其实不需要来逗我开心。

sentences.en: This is disappointment and I will move through it.
sentences.zh: 这是失望，我会走出来的。

sentences.en: But right now I'm sitting with it because I'm a human and that's what we do.
sentences.zh: 但现在我只是静静地去感受它，因为我是个人，这就是我们会做的事。

sentences.en: So I'm really hoping that all of you get the news that you want.
sentences.zh: 所以我真的希望你们所有人都能听到你们想要的好消息。

sentences.en: Um, but obviously more of the personal stories for people that I've been involved with during this application season are people in my aspiring psychologist membership.
sentences.zh: 嗯，但显然，在这个申请季里与我有过接触的人的更多个人故事，是关于我的有志心理学家会员群里的人。

sentences.en: I just want to take a moment to read you a little review, um, about a session that someone attended recently.
sentences.zh: 我只想花点时间给你读一读一条简短的评价，嗯，关于最近有人参加过的一个会议。

sentences.en: So this says, um, so the question was, does this, did this session better prepare you for your journey as an aspiring psychologist?
sentences.zh: 所以这里写着，嗯，所以问题是，这次会议是否让你为成为有志心理学家的征程做好了更充分的准备？

sentences.en: And the answer was definitely, I find the membership so helpful and it gives me more confidence that I can speak and formulate an answer on the spot.
sentences.zh: 答案是肯定的，我觉得会员服务非常有帮助，它给了我更多的信心，让我能够即兴发言并组织出答案。

sentences.en: So if that feels like something that you have struggled with in the past, really, you know, getting everything you need to do to fully enrich your answers, to be able to
sentences.zh: 所以，如果这感觉像是你过去一直在苦恼的事情，真的，你知道的，获得你需要的一切来丰富你的答案，能够

sentences.en: get the depth of answers that you might well need for psychology interviews, then do please consider coming on board to the aspiring psychologist membership.
sentences.zh: 获得心理学面试可能需要的深度答案，那么请考虑加入有志心理学家会员计划。

sentences.en: It's 30 pounds a month, but there's no minimum term.
sentences.zh: 费用是每月30英镑，但没有最低期限要求。

sentences.en: So you can leave if you decide it's not for you.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你觉得不适合自己，随时可以退出的。

sentences.en: And if research is a tricky area for you, then don't worry, we've got that covered too.
sentences.zh: 如果研究对你来说是个棘手领域，那么别担心，我们这也为你准备好了。

sentences.en: So when asked, um, about our research, um, about our research session, um, whether it had been useful, somebody had said, it was literally
sentences.zh: 因此，当被问及，嗯，关于我们的研究，嗯，关于我们的研究会议，嗯，它是否有用时，有人曾说，这简直是

sentences.en: everything I could ask for when prepping for the research aspects of the interview.
sentences.zh: 我在准备面试的研究相关部分时所能要求的一切。

sentences.en: What is not to like?
sentences.zh: 有什么理由不喜欢呢？

sentences.en: So yeah, if you feel like that would be useful, those two examples would be useful for you, then come on board.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，如果你觉得这会有用，这两个例子对你会有用，那就加入我们吧。

sentences.en: The water is lovely.
sentences.zh: 水温正好。

sentences.en: But I do still, of course, um, passionate about offering free support for you, whatever stage you're at in your journey.
sentences.zh: 当然，我仍然，嗯，热衷于为你提供免费支持，无论你处于旅程的哪个阶段。

sentences.en: So these podcasts will remain.
sentences.zh: 所以这些播客将会继续保留。

sentences.en: And of course, we've got the compassionate Q and a that you can come along to live.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们还有富有同情心的问答环节，你可以来参加直播。

sentences.zh: 所以我们有3月13日星期一，那场其实并没有真正发生过。

sentences.en: It did in fact happen on Tuesday, the 13th of March, and you can catch that on my YouTube channel.

sentences.zh: 请记住，《临床心理学家合集》这本书和《有志

sentences.zh: 嗯，并随时让我了解你最近的近况，

sentences.zh: 嗯，如果你对未来的播客节目有什么想法，觉得对你目前处于的职业阶段有所帮助，请务必联系我并告诉我。
